items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: Johnny Benson told me that Ray was on the piano.

ctx.x: Well, a number of people told me.

Well I was at the session and Ray and I are very good friends. And I didn't see him on the session. That's why I asked you how you knew he was on the session. They cut him over here. At that time, Carson had a studio on North Ramport Street. Johnny Benson told me that Ray was on the piano. Well if they did, they built the piano after you cut the session. I can't tell you what they have, but he went on the session here in New Orleans. Johnny Benson was the one. Do you know who played piano then?
Well, they took him to California and took him to California and took him to California and built the piano in. He wasn't here on the session here. He was not on the session.
